tone_target: Interstellar — practical-feeling analog/digital hybrid tech, teal/amber grade, volumetric light, quiet gravity, camera that holds rather than cuts frantically.

M.description: 50s, close-cropped silver hair, weathered calm face, deep navy flight suit with a worn embroidered insignia, thin wire-frame glasses that catch console light. Moves deliberately, speaks in short declarative lines. Quiet authority, not flashy.

F.description: Late 20s, short dark hair, olive field jacket over a grey thermal, sleeves often pushed up, expressive hands mid-gesture. Leans in when explaining. Makes the complex feel obvious.

Y.description: Mostly camera POV / over-the-shoulder silhouette. When face is needed: plain flight jacket, breath faintly visible, hands holding a slate/tablet. Audience surrogate.

sets.name: Ship Bridge
sets.description: Circular chamber, wraparound curved monitor bank, central holo-table, warm amber practicals against cool blue ambient wash, dust motes in light shafts, deep shadow falloff at frame edges.

sets.name: Cockpit/Ship interior
sets.description: Tighter, analog toggle switches under glass, small round viewports, warm interior light shifting to red-alert wash during tense beats.

sets.name: Data Vault
sets.description: Industrial, brutalist interior, massive pulsating central core, complex geometric circuitry on walls, dim flickering lights.

sets.name: Screen inserts (math)
sets.description: Pure black background, glowing cyan-white equations, no clutter — legibility over decoration.

camera_grammar.description: Handheld-but-stabilized, subtle breathing sway — this is the audience.
Classic over-the-shoulder, soft foreground blur of Y's shoulder/collar.
Symmetric framing with Y implied just off-camera between them.
Reserved only for revelations/emotional beats, never for teaching beats.
Close on Y or F's face watching a screen, keeps humans present during math-heavy beats.

visual_style_bible.grade: Teal shadows, warm amber highlights, light film grain, gentle anamorphic horizontal flare off any screen source.
visual_style_bible.golden_rule: Never let a Manim insert run alone for its full duration. Open on a human gesture toward the screen, hold the insert, close on a reaction.

scenes.beat: Alarm triggers. M: "We're picking up something. It's not noise — it's repeating." Signal freezes as number pairs. Title card: THE AETHELGARD DISTORTION.

shots.flux_frame: The scout ship 'Euler' drifting near a massive, shimmering temporal rift, teal and amber light bleeding from the core, deep space background
shots.wan_motion: Slow tracking shot toward the ship, stars twinkling slightly

shots.flux_frame: Bridge interior, M and F at the console, red emergency lights pulsing, monitors showing chaotic waves
shots.wan_motion: Handheld sway, alarm lights pulsing on rhythm
shots.dialogue: M: "We're picking up something. It's not noise — it's repeating."

shots.flux_frame: Main screen showing flickering pairs of numbers: (1.2, 4.5), (2.8, 9.1), etc.
shots.wan_motion: Numbers scroll rapidly then freeze on a single pair

shots.flux_frame: The frozen numbers dissolve into the title 'The Aethelgard Distortion' in sleek metallic font
shots.wan_motion: Slow zoom into title, light flare across the text

scenes.title: The Sensor Problem
scenes.beat: The raw pairs from the sensors are confusing the navigation grid. M explains they must be treated as single entities.

shots.flux_frame: M stands before a wall of holographic screens showing chaotic data, looking stressed but focused
shots.wan_motion: M moves his hand across a holographic interface, causing data to ripple
shots.dialogue: M: "The sensors are feeding us raw pairs. They don't align with our 3D grid. We can't navigate this way."

shots.flux_frame: M points to a specific (x,y) pair on the screen, Y's shoulder in the foreground
shots.wan_motion: Subtle camera shake, M's expression of frustration
shots.dialogue: M: "Is it one thing or two? We need to treat these as a single unified entity."

shots.flux_frame: F enters the frame, placing a hand on the console, looking at Y
shots.dialogue: F: "It's a complex entity. If we treat them as a single coordinate in a complex plane, the math stabilizes."

scenes.title: Standardizing the Data
scenes.beat: Human frame shows F explaining the shift from pairs to a+ib, followed by Manim demonstration.

shots.flux_frame: F gesturing towards a blank screen
shots.dialogue: F: "We need to convert these pairs into a format the computer can actually parse."

shots.flux_frame: Black background. (x,y) dots appear on a grid. A bracket appears. They morph into z = a + ib.
shots.wan_motion: Manim motion: dots pulse, text morphs smoothly, z = a+ib glows cyan

shots.flux_frame: Close on Y's face, lit by the cyan math glow, eyes widening slightly

scenes.title: Modulus and Phase
scenes.beat: F explains the physical meaning of the complex number (strength and phase) to find the rift center.

shots.flux_frame: F and M looking at a new 3D render of the rift, teal light reflecting off their faces
shots.wan_motion: The 3D rift model in the background pulses
shots.dialogue: F: "The 'modulus' is the signal strength—how hard the rift is pushing. The 'amplitude' is the phase shift—the rotation angle."

shots.flux_frame: F pointing at a graph showing a curve, Y's silhouette in the foreground
shots.dialogue: F: "If we know both, we know if it's expanding or contracting."

shots.flux_frame: M and F looking at a 2D plane appearing on the screen, a center point glowing
shots.wan_motion: M nods slowly as the point locks
shots.dialogue: M: "Plot it on the Argand plane. Let's see the shape of the beast."

scenes.title: The Argand Map
scenes.beat: Manim shows the modulus/argument formulas and the construction of the Argand Diagram.

shots.flux_frame: M gesturing to the screen for the final mapping
shots.dialogue: M: "Convert the raw data to polar coordinates."

shots.flux_frame: Black background. Formulas |z| = sqrt(a^2+b^2) and theta = Arg(z) appear. Then a plot of z = r(cos theta + i sin theta) builds an Argand Diagram.
shots.wan_motion: Manim motion: Formulas appear, then a vector grows from the origin to a point, labeling the components

shots.flux_frame: Close on Y's face as the full Argand Diagram completes, showing the rift's center

scenes.title: Frequency Overflow
scenes.beat: The rift core begins spinning at high frequency. M realizes iterative calculation will crash the ship's computer.

shots.flux_frame: Ship Bridge, alarms blaring red. The main screen shows a core spinning so fast it's a blur. M's face is illuminated by red light
shots.wan_motion: Screen content blurs rapidly, camera shakes slightly
shots.dialogue: M: "It's spinning too fast. The computer's trying to calculate every single rotation step... it's going to hit a buffer overflow!"

shots.flux_frame: M typing furiously, then stops, eyes widening as he finds a solution
shots.wan_motion: Rapid typing motion, then a sudden freeze
shots.dialogue: M: "We can't calculate each step. We need a shortcut. We need a rotation theorem."

shots.flux_frame: The computer screen showing 'SYSTEM OVERLOAD' warning in large red letters

scenes.title: The Theorem Shortcut
scenes.beat: Manim delivers De Moivre's Theorem as the solution to the high-frequency rotation.

shots.flux_frame: M pointing at a terminal, looking determined
shots.dialogue: M: "De Moivre's Theorem. It bypasses the iterations entirely."

shots.flux_frame: Black background. Formula [r(cos theta + i sin theta)]^n = r^n(cos n*theta + i sin n*theta) appears in glowing white.
shots.wan_motion: Manim motion: The 'n' power is highlighted, and the formula expands to show the final state in one step

shots.flux_frame: Close on Y's face, light from the theorem reflecting in eyes

scenes.title: The Satellite Ring
scenes.beat: The core's anchor points are revealed as a symmetrical ring. F realizes they can be targeted simultaneously using roots of unity.

shots.flux_frame: Ship Bridge, F looking at a circular diagram of six satellites surrounding the core
shots.dialogue: F: "The core is anchored by a ring of satellites. They're perfectly symmetrical. If we can hit them all in one pulse, the core locks."

shots.flux_frame: F gesturing at the circular symmetry of the dots on the screen
shots.dialogue: F: "We need to find the coordinates for every point on that circle simultaneously."

shots.flux_frame: M and F looking at each other, then back at the screen
shots.wan_motion: M nods, F begins to type
shots.dialogue: M: "The roots of unity. They're the only way to map perfect circular symmetry."

scenes.title: Roots of Unity
scenes.beat: Manim shows the roots of unity as geometric points on a circle.

shots.flux_frame: F pointing to the circle of satellites
shots.dialogue: F: "Every root is an anchor point."

shots.flux_frame: Black background. Equation z^n = 1 leads to z = cos(2k*pi/n) + i sin(2k*pi/n). Points appear on a circle in the complex plane.
shots.wan_motion: Manim motion: The roots of unity appear as points on a unit circle, connected by lines to the origin

shots.flux_frame: Close on Y's face, watching the geometric points lock into place

scenes.title: The Parabolic Shield
scenes.beat: A kinetic shield activates. F models the shield's arch as a quadratic curve to find the breach point.

shots.flux_frame: Cockpit, ship interior. A massive parabolic shield of orange energy appears outside the viewport
shots.dialogue: F: "Shield's up! It's not a wall, it's an arch. The energy density follows a parabolic curve."

shots.flux_frame: F leaning over a console, tracing a curve on a screen
shots.dialogue: F: "We need to calculate the exact time to cross the curve or we'll be crushed by the peak pressure."

shots.flux_frame: Close on the screen showing a red quadratic arch being traced by a white ship trajectory line
shots.wan_motion: Ship trajectory line moves toward the peak of the arch

scenes.title: Quadratic Equations
scenes.beat: Manim shows the general quadratic equation and the ship's trajectory model.

shots.flux_frame: F pointing to the parabolic curve
shots.dialogue: F: "The path is a quadratic equation."

shots.flux_frame: Black background. ax^2 + bx + c = 0 appears. A parabola is drawn, and the ship's path is overlaid.
shots.wan_motion: Manim motion: Equation appears, then a graph of the parabola is drawn, highlighting the 'arch'

shots.flux_frame: Close on Y's face, watching the path align with the arch

scenes.title: The Safe Corridor
scenes.beat: The ship needs to find the 'eye' of the shield and stay within a safe pressure corridor.

shots.flux_frame: Cockpit interior, ship interior. M is looking at the pressure gauges, which are flickering wildly
shots.wan_motion: Gauges move rapidly, cockpit lights turn orange
shots.dialogue: M: "The pressure is fluctuating. We need the point of minimum energy—the eye of the shield."

shots.flux_frame: M pointing at a range of values on a screen
shots.dialogue: M: "And we can't just hit one point. We need a safe corridor of pressure, or the hull fails."

shots.flux_frame: F and M looking at the screen together, intense focus
shots.wan_motion: M and F both lean in as the ship enters the shield zone
shots.dialogue: F: "I'm defining the safe zone now."

scenes.title: Vertex and Inequalities
scenes.beat: Manim shows the vertex formula and the inequality corridor.

shots.flux_frame: F pointing at the graph's lowest point
shots.dialogue: F: "Find the vertex, find the eye."

shots.flux_frame: Black background. Vertex formula x = -b/2a appears. Then an inequality ax^2 + bx + c < K appears, shaded as a corridor.
shots.wan_motion: Manim motion: Vertex is highlighted on a parabola, then the inequality corridor is shaded on a second graph

shots.flux_frame: Close on Y's face, watching the ship slide into the shaded corridor

scenes.title: The Linked Keys
scenes.beat: The ship reaches the core. A massive polynomial vault stands in the way. M finds a hint about 'linked' keys.

shots.flux_frame: Data Vault, massive digital vault door with rotating polynomial coefficients on its surface, industrial/brutalist look
shots.wan_motion: Vault door rotates slightly, coefficients flicker
shots.dialogue: M: "The vault's polynomial is too massive to factorize in real-time. We need a different approach."

shots.flux_frame: M points to a small manual tablet that shows a hint: 'Two keys are linked by a double-bond'
shots.dialogue: M: "The manual says two keys are linked. One is exactly double the other."

shots.flux_frame: F and M looking at the vault surface, M's face determined
shots.wan_motion: M begins inputting data into the console
shots.dialogue: F: "If they're linked, we can reduce the variables."

scenes.title: Viete's Shortcut
scenes.beat: Manim shows Viete's formulas and the substitution for linked roots.

shots.flux_frame: M pointing to the vault's coefficients
shots.dialogue: M: "We use the relations between roots and coefficients."

shots.flux_frame: Black background. Sum/Product formulas for roots appear. Then substitution alpha_1 = 2*alpha_2 is shown.
shots.wan_motion: Manim motion: Viete's formulas appear, then the substitution reduces a large polynomial to a solvable system

shots.flux_frame: Close on Y's face, watching the vault's coefficients start to turn green

scenes.title: The Shadow Conjugate
scenes.beat: A complex key is found, but only one slot remains. M realizes the conjugate key must be the shadow.

shots.flux_frame: Data Vault, vault door is partially open, one slot glowing blue, one slot empty
shots.dialogue: M: "I've found one complex key... but the vault only has one more slot. The data might be corrupted."

shots.flux_frame: M looking at the vault, eyes narrowing as he sees the coefficients
shots.dialogue: M: "No. For real coefficients, complex roots must appear in conjugate pairs. Its shadow is the key."

shots.flux_frame: Close on the terminal showing a complex number p + iq, then it mirrors to p - iq
shots.wan_motion: The complex number mirrors across the real axis

scenes.title: The Mirror Vault
scenes.beat: Manim shows the conjugate pair theorem and the reciprocal transformation for the final lock.

shots.flux_frame: F pointing at the final lock
shots.dialogue: F: "The final lock is a mirror vault. We need the inverses."

shots.flux_frame: Black background. Formula for conjugate pairs appears. Then substitution x = 1/y is shown.
shots.wan_motion: Manim motion: Conjugate pairs are shown, then the equation is transformed into its reciprocal form

shots.flux_frame: Close on Y's face, watching the vault door finally slide fully open

scenes.title: Mastery of the Stars
scenes.beat: The vault opens, the core is secured. The rift stabilizes, and the crew looks out at the stars.

shots.flux_frame: Data Vault, the central core is now glowing a soft, stable white. The door is wide open.
shots.wan_motion: The core pulses slowly, light spreading into the room
shots.dialogue: M: "Data core secured. The distortion... it's stabilizing."

shots.flux_frame: The ship 'Euler' pulling away from the now-calm rift, the starfield beautiful and still
shots.wan_motion: Ship moves slowly away, rift fades into a dull shimmer
shots.dialogue: F: "We mastered the math of the stars today."

shots.flux_frame: Faint glow of the stars, title 'MISSION COMPLETE' fades in
